subject: english
question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

My twin boys are **very restless about something** today.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"restless"** means unable to rest or relax due to anxiety or boredom. (बेचैन)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt **restless** and decided to go for a walk to clear her mind.
 
 
 
• **"Have ants in their pants"** refers to being very restless or impatient. (बहुत बेचैन होना)
 
 
• **Example: **The children **had ants in their pants **as they eagerly waited for the carnival to start.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Have ants in their pants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Green with envy** (ईर्ष्या से हरा): Very jealous.

 
 
• **Example:** She was green with envy when she saw her friend's new car.
 
 
 
• **Off on the wrong foot** (गलत शुरुआत होना): To start something in a bad way.
 
 
• **Example: **They got off on the wrong foot when they argued on their first date.
 
 
 
• **In the dark** (अंधेरे में होना): Unaware or uninformed.
 
 
• **Example:** I was kept in the dark about the company's plans to relocate.
 
 

36:Tc6e,
The correct answer is **Option 1**
